steps.title: Open System Settings
steps.explanation: Open the System Settings app on your Mac. It is the gear icon in the Dock.

steps.title: Open Battery Health details
steps.explanation: Click Battery in the left list. Then click the small i button next to Battery Health.

steps.title: Read your battery condition
steps.explanation: Look at Battery Condition. If it says Normal, the battery is fine. If it says Service Recommended, check the Maximum Capacity. Under 80% means it may need replacing.

steps.title: Open System Information
steps.explanation: To see the charge cycle count, hold down the Option key and click the Apple menu in the top left. Then choose System Information. Without Option, you will see About This Mac instead.

steps.title: Find the cycle count
steps.explanation: Click Power under Hardware on the left. Under Health Information, look for Cycle Count. Modern MacBooks are rated for about 1000 cycles.
